intent: Repair the Fresh-Agent Continuity Drill harness after the seq111 external report demonstrated that v2 could treat a contentless literal 'cue' as a completed DUMB-02/DUMB-03 stage. Extend the existing continuity/governance owners so a valid external cue must carry the actual stage payload, the subject is explicitly required to read and answer that payload after delivery, invalid or empty cue envelopes do not advance the stage, and a machine-validatable v3 report cannot PASS unless the accepted cue payloads match the controller-owned canonical cue digests. Preserve genuine fresh-session isolation, staged delivery, report-only mutation, live-head verification, bounded historical recall and the prohibition on reading prior reports/controller content before completion.
rationale_summary: The seq111 report is a real harness counterexample: the subject received only the literal word 'cue' for DUMB-02 and DUMB-03, correctly refused to invent hidden questions, yet the v2 report shape still allowed those stages to be marked pass and the overall result to self-declare PASS. The defect is therefore not Longcycle semantic recovery but cue-transport ambiguity plus missing report validation. CAP-0009 already owns fresh-agent continuity/handoff semantics and CAP-0010 owns governance gates; no new semantic owner is needed.
